NDT software in Cleveland: steel, aerospace, nuclear and the lake

Cleveland's inspection market grew out of heavy industry and never really left it. Cleveland-Cliffs, headquartered in the city, runs the Cleveland Works steel mill on the Cuyahoga River. The region has a long aerospace and precision manufacturing tradition, from forging and machining shops that supply engine and airframe parts to NASA's Glenn Research Center at the airport. Northeast Ohio is also the home of Lincoln Electric and a dense network of welding, fabrication, valve, fitting and motion-control manufacturers. The Perry nuclear plant sits on the lake east of the city, the Port of Cleveland handles Great Lakes and ocean-going ships, and paint and coatings are a major local industry, with Sherwin-Williams headquartered downtown.

The typical Cleveland NDT contractor splits time between shop and field. Shop work means UT, MT, PT, RT and PAUT on fabrications, forgings, castings and pressure-retaining parts, often under strict customer quality requirements. Field work means mill outages, nuclear and fossil outages, vessel and dock work, and structural inspection. That combination produces a lot of paperwork: customer-specific report formats, non-conformance handling, calibration evidence and, for marine work, class-society documents. The Atlantis ERP solution is built to carry that paperwork. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Cleveland: the direct answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Cleveland needs to handle shop-floor inspection for demanding manufacturing customers and field work at mills, power plants and the port from one set of records. The Atlantis ERP brings certifications, procedures, instruments, dispatch, reports, quoting and invoicing together so every result is traceable.

A generic ERP was designed around buying, making and selling products. It has no idea that a UT report needs a probe calibration table, that a technician's Level II MT certificate expires next month, or that a vessel report must carry the class-society certificate. The Atlantis ERP was built around those NDT-specific requirements, with each module listed on the ERP apps page. Where a Cleveland customer needs something extra, it is configured during implementation.

NDT reporting software for fabrication, forging and coatings work

The Atlantis NDT reporting module supports 17 report types, each with its own numbering sequence: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, Hardness, UT thickness, Ferrite, Holiday/coating and Computed Radiography. Reports follow draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for a third-party or authorized inspector.

Cleveland shop work uses the less common report types as much as the familiar ones. Ferrite reports matter on stainless and duplex fabrications. Holiday/coating reports fit the region's coatings and lined-vessel work. PWHT and Hardness reports sit alongside weld inspection on pressure-retaining fabrications, and PMI verifies alloy on incoming material. UT reports carry a probe calibration table; RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; PAUT reports capture focal laws; weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation. Every report has an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks, and references to the work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard.

When a part or weld fails, NCR and CAPA workflows configured during implementation link the non-conformance to the report and job. Reports print from versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, and customer Excel forms fill automatically by mapping fields to cells. For 3D reporting, see Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Marine NDT reporting for Great Lakes vessels and the Port of Cleveland

The Atlantis ERP has a marine mode for vessel inspection reports. It adds a vessel cover page and photo, inspection location and dates, and the PDF merges the classification-society certificate, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into one document.

Cleveland contractors inspect lakers, tugs, barges and port structures, and ship owners and surveyors want complete packs, not loose attachments. The class-society library includes DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS and ClassNK. Inspection photos lay out in a two-up grid. UT thickness readings by direction, MT and VT on welds and structure, and PAUT where required all fit the same marine report pack. Because the technician's certificate and the instrument's calibration certificate are pulled from the system rather than attached by hand, the pack is right the first time.

Technician certification tracking software for shop and outage crews

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP stores each certificate as a structured record and computes status automatically: active, expiring soon within 90 days, expired or revoked. It supports SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes.

In the Certificates app, each record holds scheme, level from trainee to Level III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam result and attachments. Aerospace-focused customers may apply their own qualification requirements, which you can record under an "other" scheme next to SNT-TC-1A. Vision tests record near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry, and examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores.

For outage work at plants like Perry, the employee NDT profile adds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days out, email alerts go to the recipients you configure, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. Company certifications such as ISO 9001 are tracked with their own alert days, which helps during customer supplier audits.

Calibration management software and accredited-lab evidence

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument and probe by serial number with calibration frequency, status and next due date, keeps a calibration certificate register with the lab's accreditation number, and warns when out-of-calibration equipment is assigned to a job.

Cleveland's manufacturing customers often ask not just whether an instrument was calibrated but by whom and against what. Calibration records in the Asset Management app store provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The Purchase app records vendor types (OEM, dealer or calibration lab) with the accredited-lab flag, accreditation number and expiry, and purchase order lines can link to a specific equipment serial, so a calibration or repair PO is tied to the instrument it was for. Inventory tracks equipment by serial and consumables alongside Asset Management.

Issue and return run through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded. The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement. Consumables such as penetrant, developer, particles and couplant carry reorder levels and low-stock flags.

Procedures and Level III control

The Procedures app holds every written procedure with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the text or uploaded file. Approved revisions are locked and every revision is kept as a snapshot.

Shops that serve several demanding customers often end up with customer-specific procedures for the same method. The register keeps them apart by document number and scope, and the workflow (draft, submitted, reviewed, approved, published, plus rejected and archived) records who prepared, reviewed and approved each revision. Approvers get email reminders. An AI-assisted first draft, with a built-in template as fallback, speeds up new procedures, and a Level III still reviews and approves them.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for mill and plant outages

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs jobs from planned to dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serials, and shows utilisation and next available date for each technician.

When a mill outage and a shop backlog compete for the same Level IIs, the Team Assignments app shows who is assigned, on leave, training, sick or unavailable, with overlaps blocked. Assignments carry site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates, and the Project app records safety induction and work permit fields, client PO, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria. Fleet records whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry. Ohio is an NRC Agreement State, so radioactive materials licensing runs through the state, and keeping vehicle, badge and training records together helps when clients or inspectors ask.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Cleveland contractors

Quoting and invoicing in the Atlantis ERP are tied to the job: quotes become sales orders, approved timesheets feed billing, and invoices show labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT services flagged by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours. Cost centres help split shop and field revenue. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup with a billable flag and overtime multiplier. The Dashboards app shows NDT KPIs such as calibration due or overdue, certificates expiring and overdue equipment returns next to the financial dashboard with revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or other API-capable systems, scoped per implementation.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Cleveland

Atlantis NDT, founded by ASNT NDT Level III Anoop Rayavarapu, implements and supports the system remotely and in phases so shop and field work continue.

  2. Data load: certifications, vision tests, instruments with calibration history, vendors and customers imported.
  3. Templates: report, marine pack, quote and invoice layouts built as versioned templates.
  4. Quality workflows: NCR and CAPA configured during implementation.
  5. Field and integration: offline app rollout and accounting connections through the REST API.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo in Cleveland

Cleveland firms often split time between a shop and the field: mill outages, aerospace parts, port work and power plants. Each has different report formats and different auditors. Test the system against that variety.

  • Show one shop job and one field job running on the same day, with separate timesheets and equipment lists.
  • Show an aerospace-style written practice recorded as a certification scheme, next to SNT-TC-1A certificates.
  • Show a marine inspection pack for a port client with the class-society certificate attached.
  • Show an NCR raised from a report finding and tracked to closure.
  • Show calibration certificates from an outside lab attached to each instrument.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Cleveland inspection company?

Software that covers shop and field work, customer-specific reports and calibration evidence in one place. The Atlantis ERP does that and is configured to your workflow.

Does it support marine inspection reports?

Yes. Marine mode adds a vessel cover page and merges the class-society, technician and calibration certificates into the report PDF.

Can it produce Ferrite and Holiday/coating reports?

Yes. Both are built-in report types, along with UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, PMI, Hardness, PWHT and more.

Can we prove our calibration lab is accredited?

Yes. Calibration records carry an accredited-lab flag, and calibration lab vendors store accreditation number and expiry.

Is it suitable for small NDT companies?

Yes. Start with core apps and add more later. Pricing is quote on request.

Does it integrate with our accounting system?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any API-capable system, scoped per implementation. Ask for a Cleveland quote.
